messages:
Maya (People Ops): quick heads-up — we're doing a leave-balance audit ahead of the fiscal cutoff on 2026-04-30. Managers need to review team balances and submit any carryover exception requests by EOD 2026-04-25.
Tasha (Eng): thanks — where's the exception form?
Maya (People Ops): use the Leave Carryover Exception form (linked in the People Ops docs). Quick steps: 1) verify balances in Rippling, 2) fill the form with reason + dates, 3) attach manager approval and submit.
Jonah (Product): does "manager approval" have to be a signed doc or an email ok?
Maya (People Ops): email approval from the manager is fine — paste it in the form's upload field. For complex cases include the 1-sentence business justification.
Sam (PM): what about folks on LOA returning after cutoff?
Maya (People Ops): LOA cases are handled case-by-case — mark "LOA" in the reason and CC people-ops@redwood.com. We'll flag those for manual review; timeline may be extended where appropriate.
Tasha (Eng): any blackout weeks where carryover can't be reviewed? we have a product freeze first week of May.
Maya (People Ops): the company blackout (annual shutdown) is still in effect for the last week of December only — the April cutoff is operational. If you have operational coverage concerns, mark "operational critical" on the form and we'll route to your manager's manager + VP for fast approval.
Jonah (Product): if a manager misses the deadline, do balances auto-forfeit?
Maya (People Ops): not immediately. People Ops will reach out to late teams for a 48-hour grace window. After that, carryover defaults to the policy cap and excess hours will be forfeited unless exception approved.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: Leave audit deadline 2026-04-25 17:00 PST. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood.com/leave-audit (access: managers only).
Tasha (Eng): ack :thumbsup:
Maya (People Ops): thanks — if any manager wants a quick sync, ping me and I can do a 15-min walkthrough of the form and Rippling export (I also dropped a 1-page checklist in #people-ops-docs).
Sam (PM): appreciated, will share with my leads.
Maya (People Ops): great — final note: if you run a manual export from Rippling, use this command in the admin console: ``export_balances --team <team_id> --format csv`` so the file matches the form upload template.
